title: Celestial Lotus Sorceress
description: A woman with purple hair and ornate jewelry sits in a meditative lotus pose at the center of a swirling cosmic vortex. She is surrounded by floating butterflies, glowing flowers, ancient East Asian architecture on a cliff, multiple celestial bodies including a blood moon and planets, and a circular band of glowing runes.
prompt: A beautiful sorceress with long flowing purple hair and intricate jewelry sits cross-legged in lotus pose at the center of a swirling cosmic portal. She wears a revealing purple outfit adorned with glowing flowers, her arms gracefully extended. Around her float colorful butterflies, sparkling crystals, and ribbons of light. In the background are ancient pagodas on misty cliffs under a night sky featuring a large blood moon, glowing planets, and stars. A circular band of glowing arcane runes encircles the scene in a vortex of purple, teal and magenta energy.
